correctness.rationale: PRESET_FALLBACK exact_success_criterion requires: fixed AG(2,13)-plus-infinity model, explicit AGL-normalization with reduction proof, enumeration over all ~371k reps with zero N=9 minimal survivors, independently recomputable. All verified. (1) Model: 183 points/lines (169 y=mx+b +13 verticals +l_inf; 14 infinity points) standard and validated by brute-force line checks in verify_target.py redei_logic_spotcheck. (2) Normalization: monic scaling D->aD (N invariant); vertical shift D invariant; x-shift g(x)=f(x+c) D invariant exactly with c=-a6/7 feasible since 7 invertible mod 13; linear shift D->D+m (N invariant). Replay normalization_invariance.py gives NORMALIZATION_INVARIANCE_OK (20 trials). Combined reduction shows every degree-7 polynomial has a normalized representative (monic, a6=0, a0=0) with same N, so enumerating C=[0,a1..a5,0,1] (13^5=371293) is complete; a1 kept free so no gap from (d). (3) Enumeration: auditor independent vectorized re-census (output/artifacts/audit_independent_recensus_deg7.py, no shared code with direc.py) returns total 371293 hist {8:13, 11:117, 12:1196, 13:369967} n9 0 AUDIT_RECENSUS_OK, byte-matching DRAFT log FALLBACK_SLICE_REPLAY_OK. Cross-checks: x^7 gives N=8 directions {1,3,4,5,8,9,10,12} matching SCOPE040; 2000 random normalized samples none N=9; verify_target.py full pure-Python recheck degrees 3-7 (deg7 restricted a1=0 subcube 28561 hist {8:1,11:9,12:92,13:28459}) consistent with full-cube scaling. (4) Blocking/minimality: with zero N=9 survivors the existential claim is vacuous, but protocol verified sound: blocking automatic (m in D blocked at infinity; m outside D gives f-mx permutation hence one affine hit; verticals meet graph once; l_inf meets D); affine-point minimality automatic via vertical tangent (infinity vertical point not in B); infinity-point tangents exist iff f-mx misses a value, guaranteed when m in D by non-injective=>non-surjective, also brute-forced over all 183 lines on x^7 VERIFY_OK. Result is proof (analytic reduction + exhaustive certificate), not experimental evidence; random samples only supporting.

Independently retrievable as citable obstruction prune for any future PG(2,13) blocking-set/direction-code search and polynomial-method benchmark even though general size-22 existence stays open. Not textbook, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration: histogram and per-function tallies are explained and the zero is non-obvious (neighboring N=8,11,12 occur). Limitations honestly stated (degree-7 family only).
